dashboard.title: Autonomous Learning System - Real-Time Transparency Dashboard
dashboard.description: Complete visibility into autonomous AI learning, decision-making, and distributed fleet activity

panels.title: 🔴 LIVE: System Activity Now
panels.description: What the system is doing RIGHT NOW

panels.title: 🗺️ Fleet Activity Map
panels.description: WHO is solving WHAT on WHICH server

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, model, workflow, task_type, phase, label, duration_ms, outcome FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-5 minutes') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 🌐 Fleet Node Distribution
panels.description: Work distribution across fleet servers

targets.query: SELECT label, COUNT(*) as count FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour') AND label IS NOT NULL GROUP BY label

panels.title: 🤖 Active AI Workers (Live)
panels.description: Which AI models are working on what tasks RIGHT NOW

targets.query: SELECT model, model_role, workflow, task_type, phase, COUNT(*) as active_count, AVG(duration_ms) as avg_duration, MAX(timestamp) as last_seen FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-2 minutes') GROUP BY model, workflow, task_type, phase ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.title: 🧠 Autonomous Decisions (Last Hour)
panels.description: ALL decisions made by the autonomous system with rationale

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, workflow, task_type, model, model_role, outcome_notes as decision_rationale FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour') AND outcome_notes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 📊 Learning Intelligence Score (LIS) Trend
panels.description: Overall system learning intelligence (0-100 aggregate improvement metric)

panels.title: 💰 Cost Tracking (Real-Time)
panels.description: Total spend and rate

targets.query: SELECT SUM(cost_usd) as total_cost FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour')
SELECT SUM(cost_usd) as session_cost FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-24 hours')

panels.title: 🎯 Model Performance Comparison
panels.description: Which models are best at what

targets.query: SELECT model, task_type, avg_quality, avg_confidence, avg_cost_usd, avg_duration_ms, sample_count FROM model_tuning ORDER BY avg_quality DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 🔍 Issue Tracker (Open/Closed/In-Progress)
panels.description: Issues found and fixed by autonomous system

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, workflow, task_type, outcome, error, outcome_notes FROM execution_log WHERE (outcome = 'failure' OR error IS NOT NULL) AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-24 hours') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 📚 Learning Sessions (Research Activity)
panels.description: What the system is researching and learning

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, workflow, task_type, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, quality_score, confidence FROM execution_log WHERE workflow LIKE '%learn%' OR workflow LIKE '%research%' AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-6 hours') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 📈 Quality Improvement Trend
panels.description: Quality scores over time (before/after learning)

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, AVG(quality_score) as avg_quality, model FROM execution_log WHERE quality_score IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY DATE(timestamp), model ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: ⚡ Discovery Timeline (What Was Learned When)
panels.description: Timeline of discoveries and improvements

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, model, task_type, 'Quality: ' || ROUND(quality_score, 2) || ' | Confidence: ' || ROUND(confidence, 2) as discovery FROM execution_log WHERE quality_score > 0.85 AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-7 days') ORDER BY timestamp DESC

panels.title: 🏆 Model Combination Synergy
panels.description: Which model combinations work best together

targets.query: SELECT task_type, worker_models, arbiter_model, avg_consensus, avg_quality, synergy_score, diversity_score, usage_count FROM model_combinations ORDER BY synergy_score DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 💸 Cost per Model (Efficiency)
panels.description: Cost efficiency by model (spend vs quality)

targets.query: SELECT model, SUM(cost_usd) as total_cost, AVG(quality_score) as avg_quality, COUNT(*) as usage_count FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_cost DESC

panels.title: 🚨 Anomaly Detection
panels.description: Performance anomalies and degradation alerts

targets.query: WITH recent_stats AS (SELECT model, task_type, AVG(quality_score) as avg_quality, STDDEV(quality_score) as stddev_quality FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-7 days') AND quality_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model, task_type) SELECT e.timestamp, e.model, e.task_type, e.quality_score, s.avg_quality, s.stddev_quality, (e.quality_score - s.avg_quality) / NULLIF(s.stddev_quality, 0) as z_score FROM execution_log e JOIN recent_stats s ON e.model = s.model AND e.task_type = s.task_type WHERE ABS((e.quality_score - s.avg_quality) / NULLIF(s.stddev_quality, 0)) > 2.5 AND e.timestamp > datetime('now', '-24 hours') ORDER BY ABS((e.quality_score - s.avg_quality) / NULLIF(s.stddev_quality, 0)) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: ⏱️ Response Time Percentiles
panels.description: P50, P95, P99 latency tracking

targets.query: WITH percentiles AS (SELECT DATE(timestamp) as date, model, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p95, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p99 FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY DATE(timestamp), model) SELECT date, model, p50, p95, p99 FROM percentiles ORDER BY date

panels.title: 🔄 Workflow Execution Pipeline
panels.description: Visual representation of active workflow stages and dependencies

targets.query: SELECT workflow, phase, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(duration_ms) as avg_duration, MAX(timestamp) as last_active FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour') GROUP BY workflow, phase ORDER BY workflow, phase

panels.title: 📊 Session Summary Dashboard
panels.description: Key metrics at a glance

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_executions FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model) as active_models FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT workflow) as active_workflows FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour')
SELECT ROUND(AVG(quality_score), 2) as avg_quality FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour') AND quality_score IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(cost_usd) as total_cost FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour')
SELECT COUNT(*) as success_count FROM execution_log WHERE outcome = 'success' AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour')

panels.title: 🔐 Audit Trail (All Actions)
panels.description: Complete audit trail of all autonomous actions with full context

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, model, model_role, workflow, task_type, phase, label, parameters, quality_score, confidence, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms, outcome, outcome_notes, error FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-6 hours') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 🎓 Prompt Pattern Performance
panels.description: Which prompt patterns work best for which models

targets.query: SELECT model, task_type, pattern_name, avg_quality, avg_confidence, usage_count, success_rate, vs_baseline_quality FROM prompt_patterns ORDER BY avg_quality DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: 🔥 Hottest Tasks (Most Active)
panels.description: Which tasks are being executed most frequently

targets.query: SELECT task_type, COUNT(*) as execution_count, AVG(duration_ms) as avg_duration FROM execution_log WHERE timestamp > datetime('now', '-1 hour') GROUP BY task_type ORDER BY execution_count DESC LIMIT 15

variables.name: model_filter
variables.label: Model
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM execution_log ORDER BY model

variables.name: workflow_filter
variables.label: Workflow
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT workflow FROM execution_log WHERE workflow IS NOT NULL ORDER BY workflow

variables.name: server_filter
variables.label: Server/Node
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT label FROM execution_log WHERE label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

list.name: Deployments
list.query: SELECT timestamp, 'Deployment: ' || outcome_notes as text FROM execution_log WHERE workflow LIKE '%deploy%' AND timestamp > $__from AND timestamp < $__to

list.name: Errors
list.query: SELECT timestamp, 'Error: ' || error as text FROM execution_log WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > $__from AND timestamp < $__to

list.name: High Quality Results
list.query: SELECT timestamp, 'Quality: ' || quality_score || ' - ' || task_type as text FROM execution_log WHERE quality_score > 0.90 AND timestamp > $__from AND timestamp < $__to
